title: System Design Lab
intro: Drag components onto the canvas, connect them, then send virtual traffic through your design. Every design has $200,000 of virtual AWS credit a month.
priceNote: Approximate AWS on-demand list prices for Mumbai, for learning only. Data transfer and storage are not counted yet.
modelNote: Capacities are rules of thumb for a typical web API, not benchmarks. The simulation shows steady load: each component's utilisation, the queueing delay it adds, and the requests it has to drop once it is past capacity.
smallScreen: The Lab is built for a laptop or tablet. On a phone you can look around, but designing is easier on a bigger screen.

components.name: Clients
components.desc: Your users' apps and browsers. Set how many requests per second they send.

components.name: API Gateway
components.desc: Managed front door: routing, authentication and throttling. Billed per request; the account limit is about 10,000 requests a second.

components.name: Server
components.desc: EC2 instances running your API. More or bigger instances handle more requests a second.

components.name: Database
components.desc: RDS for PostgreSQL. By default every request that reaches a server makes one query. Multi-AZ keeps a standby copy and doubles the price.
